title: Intake & map
covers: suggested refs for the income statement, balance sheet and P&L

steps.say: Bring the client's statements and final accounts into SimplyFile and give every row its SF Ref - most are suggested for you.
Choose the client and year; their statements are listed here.
Excel or CSV. The same file again offers to replace it - refs stay on unchanged rows and the old version is kept.
Rows come grouped under the statement's own headings. Each heading adds up the way the statement means it - Less: rows taken off - and is checked against the statement's own total.
Most rows are already suggested: income heads, TDS, 3CD clauses - and under a Balance Sheet or P&L heading, items like ITR3 BS debtors or ITR3 PL salaries. Accept them all, then fix the few left.
A long statement? Search by row number, words, heading, SF Ref or amount - any part, any order.
Every change is saved; the stage moves on once every row has a valid ref.
Every change, field by field - was, now, when and who - and every earlier version of a statement, ready to download.
